raw: {"vulnerable": true, "class": "Missing account validation (unverified sysvar account)", "why": "The `instruction_acc` is an unchecked `Info` and is never compared against `solana_program::sysvar::instructions::id()`, so an attacker can pass a forged instructions-sysvar account containing a fake secp256k1 verification instruction and get arbitrary guardian signatures marked as valid."}

{"vulnerable": false, "class": "", "why": "The instruction-sysvar account is validated via load_current_index_checked/load_instruction_at_checked, the guardian set PDA derivation is verified, the secp program id and per-signature offsets/instruction indices are checked, and existing signature sets are matched on hash and guardian set index, so the known Wormhole spoofed-sysvar flaw is fixed."}
